# Glossary — Stockroom

One line per business term. If two people could understand a word differently,
it belongs here. Code, docs and agents must use these exact names.

Terms below follow the names used on the floor, not the names in the old ERP.
When the two differ, the ERP name goes in "Not to be confused with".

| Term (code name)      | Definition                             | Not to be confused with    | Display name |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------- | -------------------------- | ------------ |
| _Example:_ `Customer` | A person who has bought at least once. | `Visitor` (has not bought) | Customer     |
| `Warehouse`           | A building that holds stock.           | `Site`                     | Warehouse    |
| `Stock move`          | One change of place of one lot.        | `Transfer` \| `Shipment`   | Stock move   |
| `Lot.Code`            | The printed code of one lot.           |                            | Lot code     |
| `Bin`                 | The smallest place stock sits.         | `Shelf`                    | Bin          |
